title: GPU queue compat wrapper calls missing _flow_publish_pinned_reservation
body: Every queued GPU/native invocation printed '/home/liory/Github/box-queue/compat/../queue/with-test-lock.sh: line 13588: _flow_publish_pinned_reservation: command not found' before continuing. The live queue should expose this helper consistently across compat and queue wrappers so reservations are published without a per-job shell error.

title: vixen-native bat loses backslashes in Windows evidence-root arguments
body: The queued command passed --evidence-root C:\vixen-native\gpuliveness1\.tmp\cx-gpuliveness1-evidence through bash -lc and tools/vixen-native.sh; native output showed C:vixen-nativegpuliveness1.tmpcx-gpuliveness1-evidence, so the batch made a malformed relative directory and did not run the scenario. Forward-slash C:/vixen-native/... arguments work around it. The native wrapper should preserve Windows path separators across its cmd.exe argument boundary.
